svg.text: 2 Generation: one Gemini 2.5-Flash call per batch
batch of 5 to 10 samples, 489-line inspector system prompt (App. B), no second model, phases 1 to 4 happen inside this one call, phase 5 runs afterwards in Python
budget 120 to 200 words, observed mean about 137 words (§3.6)
Normal cases must still be specific
Real-IAD codes are mapped to a generic vocabulary,
which enables zero-shot transfer to MVTec AD and VisA
location snaps to the grid, type to one of 26 labels,
both are checked by the schema gate in phase 4
Phase 4: trace validation gate, silent self-scoring
8-category acceptance filter, {0, 1, 2} each, accept at 13 / 16 or higher
6 auto-reject rules, from batch leakage to unsupported defect claim
trace rewrite policy: rewrite the lowest-scoring categories, re-emit in the same call
schema validation with Pydantic, a malformed batch is regenerated
scores never logged, no second reviewer, no human filter, no ranked selection
Phase 5: after the call, dataset processing
mask, overlay, reference normal, gold verdict, gold type
the teacher used them, the corpus never contains them
one C1 image and one trace
the student never sees the rest
Section 2 of the AnomalyThink construction: how a trace is written, vetted, normalised and stripped.
